source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第一、二节

textbook_summary: P rounded, duration < 120 ms and limb-lead amplitude < 250 uV.
PR measured P onset to QRS onset; normal-rate reference 120-200 ms.
Q duration <=30 ms and depth <=one quarter R for applicable leads.
J is QRS end; ST extends to T onset; baseline chosen zero.
T slower rising limb and steeper falling limb; same dominant polarity as R.
QT measured QRS onset to T end; 320-440 ms at 60-100/min is a population reference, not a fixed-rate law.
authorship: Project-authored landmarks within cited qualitative/interval constraints; no traced textbook image or upstream table
scope: Positive-dominant single-lead illustration; not an electrode projection or twelve-lead preset
offline_interpolation: Exact-rational monotone cubic smoothstep per landmark interval, nearest ties to even Q32; runtime PeriodicLutLinear@1
constraints: R-to-S descent connects peak landmarks without an intermediate zero-slope baseline knot
